questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement.

**Statement:**

All refrigerators are television sets.

Some speakers are television sets.

All speakers are fans.

**Conclusion:**

I. Some fans are television sets.

II. Some television sets are refrigerators.

III. No fans is a speaker

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow.
Only conclusions I and II follow.
Only conclusions II and III follow.

questions.solution:
The figure given below

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6340f189d1c378261065c42b555d0a3f3a36576b96c9f5f0d533b8fff94b3a0d.png] 

I. Some fans are television sets. → True (Some speakers are television sets. All speakers are fans.)

II. Some television sets are refrigerators. → True (All refrigerators are television sets.)

III. No fans is a speaker → False (Some speakers are television sets. All speakers are fans.)

Only conclusion I and conclusion II follows.

Hence, option 3 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
If 'A' denotes 'addition', 'B' denotes 'multiplication', 'C' denotes 'subtraction', and 'D' denotes 'division', then what will be the value of the following expression?

27 A (15 C 3) B 4 A 16 D 4 = ?
questions.solution:
Given that -

 'A' denotes 'addition', 'B' denotes 'multiplication', 'C' denotes 'subtraction', and 'D' denotes 'division',

= 27 + (15 - 3) × 4 + 16 ÷ 4

Applying BODMAS rule-

= 27 + 12 × 4 + 16 ÷ 4

= 27 + 12 × 4 + 4

= 27 + 48 + 4

= 79

Hence, 79 is the correct answer.

Some plates are bowls.

I. Some bowls are spoons.

II. Some bowls are plates.

options.text: Either conclusion I or II follows.
Both the conclusions I and II follow.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7999d43df7116893541da8f82342134a8288f8e264c7f7846fafabd667434521.png] 

I. Some bowls are spoons. → False (It is possible but not definite)

II. Some bowls are plates. → True (Some plates are bowls.)

Hence, option 1 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?

3, 2, 3, 8, 31, ?
questions.solution:
The given series

3, 2, 3, 8, 31, ?

3 × 1 - 1 = 2

2 × 2 - 1 = 3

3 × 3 - 1 = 8

8 × 4 - 1 = 31

31 × 5 - 1 = 154

Hence, 154 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

8 : 514 :: 11 :?
questions.solution:
8 is related to 514 as:

8³ + 2 = 512 + 2

 = 514

Similarly,

11³ + 2 = 1331 + 2

 = 1333

8 : 514 :: 11 : 1333.

Hence, option 1 is the correct answer.
